bootstrap.procedure: Python random.Random; 85 draws with replacement per resample; arithmetic mean; linearly interpolated percentiles 0.025 and 0.975

old_new_comparability_rule: Compare same trial ID and identical named normalized progress, action-role count, L3 status and completed-cycle fields only; rate denominator is each run's completed cycles. Any field lacking proof of like-for-like semantics is NOT_SEMANTICALLY_COMPARABLE.

typed_mechanism_rules.when: missing trace/summary or incomplete cycle-cardinality evidence
first terminal cycle <= 100, terminal fraction last100 >= 0.9, longest terminal run >= 250
L3 fail rate >= 0.5 and terminal rate >= 0.5, with typed L3 status evidence
L3 fail rate >= 0.5, backup rate <= 0.05, terminal rate >= 0.4
primary and terminal counts > 0 and both action-role transitions are observed
none of the prior rules apply

mechanism_rule_order: first matching rule wins; labels are descriptive trace patterns, not causal determinations
causal_root_claim_rule: Only if tail/broad pattern, strong routing association, >=6 of bottom10 share the same nontrivial typed mechanism, and any comparable old/new routing changes are directionally consistent; otherwise NO_SINGLE_CAUSAL_ROOT_ESTABLISHED.
